root_system.label: writable
root_system.note: Active root filesystem—do not target for multiboot operations.

advice: Do NOT run partition.sh with --execute --yes until you really intend to repartition /dev/sda.
All scripts default to dry-run; confirm device each time.
Back up /dev/sda1 if it contains any needed firmware before relabeling or wiping.
